title: Privacy
summary: Sundae is your week in photos, shared with a small group of friends and family. Here is what it uses to work, what it never asks for, and who sees what.

sections.title: What Sundae uses
items: A private ID from Sign in with Apple, so you can sign back in. Never your email.
Your name, username, bio and profile photo, if you add them.
The photos you post, with their captions and tags, so the people you choose can see them.
Who you follow, your likes and comments, and which ideas you did, once one has photos.
Your settings, your time zone so Sunday starts at your midnight, and any reports you send.

sections.title: What Sundae never collects
items: Your location. Ideas near you are picked and written on your phone. Map and weather lookups use only a rough area with nothing that identifies you, and where you are never reaches Sundae.
Where your photos were taken. Location and camera details are removed before a photo leaves your phone, and again when it arrives.
The ideas you save and the photos you keep with them. Sundae matches photos to the places you saved by where they were taken, on your phone, and all of it stays there until you post on Sunday.
Your contacts. Sundae never asks for them.
Anything for ads or tracking. No ads, no analytics, no trackers.

sections.title: Who sees what
items: Your weeks are seen by your followers, or by anyone on Sundae if your account is public. You can see and remove your followers in Settings.
Photos only open through private links that stop working within hours.
Your photos are never sold, shared or used for anything else, and nobody looks through them. A photo someone reports may be looked at to handle the report.

sections.title: How it is protected
items: Sign in with Apple only, so there is no password to steal.
Everything is encrypted on the way and where it is stored.
Sessions expire on their own, and Sign out everywhere ends them on every device.

sections.title: Deleting it
items: Delete account, in Settings, removes your account, photos, comments, likes and tags right away.
Photos are gone for good at once. A short recovery history of the rest, there only to undo mistakes, clears within 7 days.
Photos you were tagged in stay in the poster's week, with your tag removed.

sections.title: Questions
items: Send feedback from TestFlight and it reaches the person who runs Sundae.
